timeline.summary: Steamhouse India Limited scheduled an earnings call for Q2 FY27 financial results on October 30, 2026, at 1:00 PM IST with **Vishal S. Budhia**, **Vaibhav Gattani**, **Dipti Seksaria**, and **Ishika Bhandari** participating.
Steamhouse India signed an MoU with the Haryana Enterprises Promotion Centre to explore ₹500 crore of industrial infrastructure opportunities.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹128 Cr, net profit ₹7.77 Cr.
Steamhouse India Q2 FY27 revenue up 2.45% YoY to ₹128 Cr;
Steamhouse India presented Q2/H1 FY27 investor update, guiding for a 30–35% EBITDA CAGR over three years and scaling green boiler capacity to 105 TPH.
Audio recording of Steamhouse India Limited's earnings call for quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 is available on the company website, recorded on 30 October 2026 at 1:00 P.M. IST.
